messages:
sofia: Quick preflight for tonight's cross-svc roll — API v2.3.1, runtime v4.0.0, console 1.9.2, and router route-pin change. Change window 23:00–00:30 UTC. Need alignment on pinning + rollback criteria.

ajay: What's the canary plan for runtime? full pin or gradual?

marie: Suggest: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m holds. Smoke checks + a small eval set run after each step. Console pinned to 1.9.2 until runtime reaches 50%.

kai: Router change is header-based routing for canary. I'll push the config but we should pin route->backend mapping for the duration to avoid cross-version session routing.

noah: Rollback playbook: if error rate >1% for 5m or p95 latency +50ms vs baseline -> immediate rollback to previous runtime. Also a manual abort if redis cache miss spike. Playbook link: https://confluence/release/playbooks/runtime-rollback

sofia: Agreed. To be explicit: API pinned to 2.3.1 during entire rollout (no partial traffic), runtime will be gradual canary, console pinned until runtime >=50%, router pinned for session stickiness. Who's owner for monitors?

ajay: I'll own the runtime monitors. Dashboard: infra/runtime/canary. Watch: error_rate, p95, CPU saturation, KV cache hit rate.

marie: Add synthetic prompt set regression: smoke prompts -> target quality score >= 0.92. I will run that automatically after each canary step.

sofia: OK owners: ajay (runtime monitors & rollback), marie (quality checks), kai (router pin), noah (playbook and ops oncall). Release notes + customer impact draft?

release-bot: Draft release notes created: https://notebooks.internal/releases/1834567890

sofia: Here's the rollout config I'll apply to the orchestrator:

```yaml
rollout:
  service: runtime
  version: v4.0.0
  steps:
    - traffic: 10%
      hold: 15m
    - traffic: 50%
      hold: 15m
    - traffic: 100%
      hold: 10m
  health_checks:
    - name: error_rate
      threshold: 1%
    - name: p95_latency
      threshold: +50ms
```

kai: Router pin config snippet I'm going to apply (will open PR):

```json
{
  "route": "api.v1.chat",
  "routing_policy": "header:canary-token",
  "pinned_backend": "runtime-v3.9.6",
  "duration": "1h"
}
```

noah: Note: set pinned_backend to runtime-v4.0.0 once we hit 50% so console -> runtime versions don't drift. Also adding a k8s rollout pause_annotation for manual rollback trigger.

deploy-bot: :gear: initiating canary for runtime v4.0.0 -> 10% at 1834567950. Canary id: cb-18345.

ajay: :thumbsup: starting monitors now. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall and pager duty.

marie: kicked off synthetic evals, initial results within 3m. I'll post summary.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: canary step 1 complete at 1834568030. No error rate spike, p95 within baseline +12ms, synthetic quality 0.93.

sofia: Great. Proceed to 50% after 15m hold. Keep the router pin in place.

kai: PR merged for router pin, will flip pinned_backend to v4.0.0 once marie/ajay sign off.

deploy-bot: :gear: promoting canary cb-18345 -> 50% at 1834568270.

marie: Running evals now. Preliminary quality hold at 0.915 (passing threshold). CPU looks OK.

ajay: Error rate stable, p95 +18ms. No alert.

noah: Manual rollback trigger prepped. If anything crosses thresholds I will execute and notify.

deploy-bot: :warning: detected cache_miss_spike at 1834568401 (KV hitrate dropped 6% for 2m). Marking as watch.

ajay: Seeing a small cache miss blip, but not sustained. Watching for 5m.

marie: quality still fine. If cache miss recovers we can continue.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: cache_miss recovered at 1834568465. No rollback.

sofia: Since all OK, kai please flip router pinned_backend to v4.0.0 and then we can finish 100% promotion.

kai: Flipped pinned_backend to v4.0.0. Confirmed session stickiness tests pass.

deploy-bot: :rocket: promoting cb-18345 -> 100% at 1834568590. Rollout complete.

release-bot: Release notes published and customer-facing summary sent to #announcements. Link: https://notebooks.internal/releases/1834567890/notes

sofia: Excellent run. Postmortem action items: add a KV hitrate early-warning to the canary playbook, and add an automated console compatibility smoke test in the pipeline. I'll file tickets.

ajay: Filing monitoring ticket now.

marie: Filing auto-eval ticket.

noah: Closing playbook gaps.

sofia: Thanks everyone. Stand down unless alerts fire. :tada:
